snapshot.text: Government-led system undergoing structural reform: a Health Holding Company is taking over regional health clusters, separating system oversight from care provision. Chronic disease and injury remain priorities; officials report life expectancy of 79.7 years.

priorities.title: Shifting clusters to Health Holding Company
priorities.text: Twenty regional health clusters are being moved to the Health Holding Company, with completion targeted for 2027, aiming to raise service quality and beneficiary satisfaction.

priorities.title: Health in All Policies and Healthy Cities
priorities.text: Health is being treated as a development priority across urban planning, environment and education, with 21 WHO-accredited Healthy Cities recognised in the Kingdom.

priorities.title: National emergency medical safety policy
priorities.text: The Council of Ministers approved a national policy to improve emergency medical readiness in public places and workplaces, led by the Saudi Red Crescent Authority.
